mentions.name: OnetimeFax
mentions.description: OnetimeFax is a pay-per-use fax service that lets users send and receive faxes for a flat fee without any subscription. It began as a personal script the author wrote to fax courts a jury duty deferral during covid lockdown, and was later productized during parental leave.
mentions.problem: Occasional fax senders are typically forced into subscriptions; this offers a flat-fee, no-subscription alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://www.OnetimeFax.com - it's a way to send and receive faxes for a flat fee without needing to subscribe to anything.
